_about: Natural spawns of each listed type stop while this many are loaded per player (vanilla's pool of 20 is unchanged). A value may be {"cap": n, "also": [types]}: those types count toward the cap too. Our salmon run counts toward vanilla's salmon, so the two compete for 10. Empty this file to switch the caps off.
_salmon: Salmon's cap is 0: vanilla's spawner places no salmon; the mod's spawner places them as one kind of the salmon run, with the same chance as each of ours (budget 'salmon' in budgets.json). Set it back to a number to let vanilla's spawner place salmon again up to that cap.
